description: This file defines an abstract class ControlCollectives within the c10d namespace, which provides an interface for distributed control operations such as barrier synchronization, broadcast, gather, scatter, all-gather, and sum. The class inherits from torch::CustomClassHolder and declares several pure virtual methods related to these collective operations, each accepting parameters like keys, data vectors, and timeouts.

classes.name: ControlCollectives
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for various distributed control collective operations within the c10d namespace.

methods.name: barrier
methods.description: Performs a barrier synchronization among distributed processes with a key and optional timeout.

methods.name: broadcastSend
methods.description: Sends data to other processes via broadcast identified by a key, with a specified timeout.

methods.name: broadcastRecv
methods.description: Receives data broadcasted with a specific key within the given timeout.

methods.name: gatherSend
methods.description: Sends data to be gathered from multiple processes, identified by a key, with a timeout.

methods.name: gatherRecv
methods.description: Receives gathered data from multiple processes for a specific key within the timeout.

methods.name: scatterSend
methods.description: Sends data to be scattered among processes, identified by a key, with a timeout.

methods.name: scatterRecv
methods.description: Receives scattered data for a specific key within the timeout.

methods.name: allGather
methods.description: Performs an all-gather operation, collecting data from all processes for a given key.

methods.name: allSum
methods.description: Performs a sum reduction across processes for a specific key.
